notes: Meteora DLMM. The swap's bin_array PDAs travel as remaining_accounts the IDL never names: seed ['bin_array', lb_pair, index(i64 LE)] (MeteoraAg/dlmm-sdk commons/src/pda.rs::derive_bin_array_pda + seeds.rs BIN_ARRAY), index = floor(bin_id / 70) (bin_array.rs::bin_id_to_bin_array_index, MAX_BIN_PER_ARRAY=70). Which indexes a swap needs comes from lb_pair.active_id + the pool's liquidity bitmap (quote.rs::get_bin_array_pubkeys_for_swap) — a LIVE STATE read, not geometry; plan_swap performs it. The index is SIGNED (negative below price 1.0). bin_array_bitmap_extension = ['bitmap', lb_pair] (optional swap account; holds liquidity flags beyond array index +/-512).

why.user_token: an ATA of the user under the SPL Associated Token program — not a PDA of this program, so it appears on neither the IDL nor the program source; hand-modelled so plans can name the user's token accounts
